ios.desc:
Leave your worries behind and enter the calm, cozy world of mowing.

Find your backyard bliss in the ultimate zen experience. Whether you're looking to relax after a long day or enjoy a satisfying ASMR session, this is the simple life you’ve been searching for. No stress, no penalties—it’s literally just mowing.

Use your mower to turn troublesome turf into a neat, tidy paradise. From lush gardens to quiet township parks, every blade of grass is a chance to find your calm.

Why you’ll love the mowing life:

- Pure ASMR Satisfaction: Experience the clean crunch of grass cutting with our advanced rendering tech. It’s the most satisfying lawn care on mobile.
- Cozy & Stress-Free: Escape the noise. Zone out with a calming idle-style flow—no scores, just pure quiet relaxation.
- Custom Mowers: Win new parts and get your mower looking real nice. There are literally thousands of combinations.
- Nature’s Beauty: Collect butterflies and explore charming yards, and nature-filled landscapes.
- Don’t forget to mow those parks and sports fields. You may find something interesting hiding beneath.
- Daily Bliss: Mow daily to earn extra rewards and keep your virtual home looking neat.

Whether you're a fan of simple simulators or just need a meditation break, everyone can enjoy the peace of a perfectly cut lawn.

It’s Literally Just Mowing: Your daily dose of garden zen.

It’s Literally Just Mowing is free, but contains in game purchases. These can be disabled in your device settings.
